property_summary: For any caller who currently has no active guess (guesses[caller].block == 0), calling lockInGuess(bytes32) with exactly 1 ether succeeds (does not revert) and records a nonzero future block; the mutant flips the guard so callers with no existing guess are rejected, causing some inputs (EOAs with no prior guess) to fail.
change_summary: Change the requirement that the sender has no existing guess from == 0 to != 0, flipping the guard so only addresses with an existing guess can call successfully.
